description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Dummaladeniya, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District (25/0347)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 5:1, 5:2, and 1:60) with detailed land ownership information, including owner names, property descriptions, locations, and encumbrances. The content falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
